summary: UC1: Console configuration — enable push on event creation
user_story: As a network admin, I want to configure whether a push notification is sent when someone creates a new event in a community, so that networks can opt in/out of event-creation pushes without changing the creation flow.
value_rationale: Network-level control; reduces accidental pushes while enabling pre-event RSVP growth for activation-heavy networks.
preconditions: Admin has access to Admin Console settings
Push notifications are enabled for the network
entry_points: A. Admin Console → Settings → Push notifications → Event-related events

push_message.example: "Ulta Beauty Community has event Ulta Beauty World Masterclass 2026" / [In-person]  10 Jul 2026 · 7:00 PM
notes: {{EventType}} chip: In-person for in-person events, Virtual for virtual/livestream events
Notification icon displays the community avatar

jack (PDT-3676 comment): 'hold on "Notify whole network for events in public communities"' — a network-wide push toggle was HELD / NOT in this scope; default push audience = community members only (contrast with tray which IS network-wide on public — TR-CL-02).
jack (PDT-3420 comment): 'We don't handle push on our side. It reuse navigation from noti tray.' — push tap-nav reuses the tray deep-link/nav path (so tray nav bug BUG-C affects push too).
No dedicated console design; implemented as one more toggle under existing event notifications (jack + Tanat screenshots 2026-07-09/10).

acceptance_criteria.scenario: Admin sees event creation push toggle
given: A network admin navigates to Admin Console → Settings → Push notifications → Event-related events
then: They see a toggle "When someone creates a new event in the community"

given: "When someone creates a new event in the community" is OFF
acceptance_criteria.when: An event is created in any community
then: No event-creation push notification is sent
The standard tray notification still fires to community members per existing behavior

given: "When someone creates a new event in the community" is ON
acceptance_criteria.when: An event is created in any community
then: A push notification is sent to all active, non-banned members of that community
The push deep-links to the event RSVP page (= event detail page where RSVP is visible, per shared tray nav)
